<explanation>
Informational/travel article format signals a factual, educational tone — a trivia or currency guide entry about Italy.

The phrase "The currency used in Italy is the official currency of the country is" sets up a factual answer about the Euro, establishing a currency fact about the Italian lira.

Final token "is" opens a predicate clause ("the currency of the country is...the currency used in Italy is"), requiring a noun phrase — almost certainly "the Euro" or "the Euro, called the lira" or "called the lira." or "the euro." — a named currency descriptor completing the sentence about the currency's name or value.
